Name: Tool Smart Switch (Updated)
Author: Fiorbeth
Description:
This is an update to the Tool Smart Switchl mod by aedenthorn following their retirement from modding. This has been updated to work with Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0.0. This was updated primarily for personal use but I decided to publish it in case anyone else used this mod and wished to do so with 1.6.

To be clear at this time the only work by me is updating a few parts to work with 1.6 the majority of the work here is by aedenthorn.

[u]Original Mod Description[/u]
This mod checks when you use a tool whether the tool is appropriate for the target. If not, it will try to switch to another tool in the current
tool bar.

Tools will switch when used on the following if an appropriate tool exists in the current tool bar:

[list]
[*]Stones (Pickaxe)
[*]Sticks (Axe)
[*]Weeds (Scythe)
[*]Scythe Crops (Scythe)
[*]Dry Tilled Farm Soil (Watering Can)
[*]Artifacts Spots (Hoe)
[*]Trees (Axe if mature, otherwise Scythe)
[*]Stumps (Axe)
[*]Boulders (Pickaxe)
[*]Grass (Scythe)
[*]Ore Panning Spots (Pan)
[*]Watering Can Fill Spots (Watering Can)
[*]Pet Bowls (Watering Can)
[*]Water tiles (Fishing Rod) - this is ignored in favour of watering cans
[*]Farm Animals (Shears or Milk Pail)
[*]Monsters (Melee Weapon) - only if facing monster, default 128 pixels away or less
[*]Tillable Soil (Hoe)
[/list]
Auto-switching can be tweaked in the config.

You can set a toggle key to turn the mod on and off in the config.

[size=5]Config
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[u]Current State
[/u]The mod currently works with 1.6 and all features seem to work, there does seem to be a bit of a detection issue if you are off centre of the block you are trying to harvest which results in the wrong tool being selected. This is fairly minor but will look into updating to resolve soon.

Repo can be found here: [url=https://github.com/NTaylor1993/ToolSmartSwitch]https://github.com/NTaylor1993/ToolSmartSwitch[/url]
